eyebrow: Serve by alias · promote · roll back
code:
client.set_registered_model_alias(
    NAME, "champion", 1)
model = mlflow.sklearn.load_model(
    "models:/cancel-risk-model@champion")

set_registered_model_alias(NAME,
    "champion", 2)   # promote
set_registered_model_alias(NAME,
    "champion", 1)   # roll back
caption: Loading the alias returned version 1's Pipeline.
